_comment: Tools served by the hosted OAuth door (https://api.xlsx-for-ai.dev/mcp) with x-xfa-toolset: all. Source: the server tool inventory (src/routes/tools-list.ts) minus commerce tools (src/mcp/claude-manifest.ts isCommerceTool) plus the door-local xlsx_upload_link. Refresh with scripts/plugin/refresh-tool-manifest.js. The session-start text is generated from this file by scripts/plugin/generate-session-start.js.
